link_filter_default: Standard Frappe Link search plus DocType permissions and User Permissions unless a form script overrides with frm.set_query.
print_default: Business fields remain printable unless print_hide is set; hashes, fingerprints, source keys, payloads, and snapshots are protected separately.
mandatory_default: reqd means required at save; mandatory_depends_on is used only for conditional requirements; server lifecycle validation remains authoritative for submit/workflow-only requirements.
currency_policy: Use Company:company:default_currency only when the same DocType has a Company field. Otherwise do not add a Currency option merely to force a symbol.
